changelog:
v2.12.3 - Eye Care keyboard fix

- FIX: Eye Care filter no longer blocks typing. Added FLAG_ALT_FOCUSABLE_IM + NOT_TOUCH_MODAL so Samsung One UI's keyboard layers above the filter instead of treating it as a tapjacking threat.
- Filter now also sets SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_NOTHING to stop keyboard flicker while the warm tint is on.
